item.description:
This was the first appearance of the transparent plastic pyramids that would become known as Icehouse Pyramids or Looney Pyramids. The clear plastic box contains four stashes (blue, green, yellow, red) and rules for Martian Chess, Zarcana, IceTowers, and IceTraders (an early version of Homeworlds). The three booklets (Ice Towers and Ice Traders share one) all end with suggestions for "other games to try" (referring readers to Looney Lab's website for the actual rules).
Also included are two Zarcana reference cards, an imprint-and-credits card, and a card with "cover art" and (on the reverse) an explanation why this product called Icehouse doesn't come with the rules for playing the game Icehouse.
"Perhaps you're wondering why we call this an Icehouse set, when the rules for the game called Icehouse aren't included with the pieces. The short answer is, it's kind of like duct tape: Few people who use duct tape actually use it on their ducts... yet everyone still calls it duct tape."
The final item in the package is a sticker featuring Tirade the Broccoli, with the peel-off sheet on the reverse advertising other Looney games as well as their Wunderland "webzine".

item.description:
Баттелі, or Illomi Chess, is a two-player strategy game played on a 20 square isometric board.
During the game each player's swordmen battles it out with each other in an abstract chain reaction battle, until there is a victor. Each of these battles bring the player's closer to the goal of capturing the king.
Rules are available in the conlang Delang (both Delang script and Latin script), English and Norwegian. All game components are language neutral. No game components are supplied from publisher.
Rules:
Each pawn can move to an adjacent square, but only one pawn may move backwards. Use a way to mark such a pawn. If a pawn has moved backward, no pawn can move backwards until a pawn has moved forward. The pawn that has moved backwards cannot move until a pawn has moved forward. If you do not have two swordmen more than your opponent, you may use your move to breed a new swordman. Only the king can breed new swordmen. The new swordman must be placed in an adjacing square to the king, and there has to be a swordman on the square already. You have to move a newly breed swordman. You have to kill an opponent's swordman that's in front of your's. If an opponent's swordman is in front of a newly breed swordman, you have to kill that swordman with your newly breed swordman.

item.description:
Komikan is a two-player abstract strategy board game from the Mapuches of Chile.
Rules It is a hunt game using an expanded Alquerque board. Like all hunt games, there are two unequal forces at play. In Komikan, one player has only a single piece (usually called a "puma", "jaguar", "komikelu", "leon" or "ukuku"), which can move one space at a time or capture the other player's pieces by hopping over them. The other player has twelve pieces (usually called "sheeps", "goats", "dogs" or "kukulis"), that can only move one space at a time, but not capture, and attempts only to surround and immobilize the puma or jaguar. All pieces must move and/or capture following the pattern on the board.
Board The expanded Alquerque board consist of an Alquerque board and a triangular patterned board attached on one of its side. The sheeps or goats can also win the game by occupying every spaces on this triangle. There are different triangular patterned board designs attached to the Alquerque board, and therefore Komikan has several variants. The standard triangular board has one horizontal line across the breadth of the triangle, and one vertical line along the length of the triangle.
According to Wikipedia, "Komikan may actually be the same game as Adugo."

item.description:
Isle of Eldermoor Chess is a large board chess variant.
It is played on a larger 10X10 board to allow more pieces, and then borrowed the idea of the Citadel corner from Omega Chess, an idea quickly expanded to an area of seven additional squares on each corner, leaving the board with a more castle-like appearance.
The game also uses the 'river' idea in the centre from Xiangqi, as well as an inner King's sanctum area,
The first goal of Isle of Eldermoor was to toss out the traditional Western Chess game. There are great variants such as Omega Chess, Opulent Chess, and Grand Chess which take the traditional game and add to it with a few new pieces. It's been done.
So only the King was transfered to Eldermoor.
The rest of the army array reflects more of a fantasy Medieval army, so Paladins, Cavaliers, Yeomen, Soldiers, Archers etc are used.
As an ode to long nights of Dungeons & Dragons over the years a fantasy element with Wizards, Griffins and Dragons are also part of the game
With an all new piece array, I needed different movement patterns, well different from Western Chess at least. There are so many variant pieces almost every conceivable movement pattern has been done before in one variant or another.
The resulting movements draw on Western Chess, Xiangqi, Shogi and related variants.
The game has three win conditions;
The game is won by checkmating the opposition king.
or
If a player loses both Wizards the morale of their army is broken and they lose the game.
or
You win by occupying both opponent's wizard towers, and holding them for one full turn.

item.description:
Popular in Europe, Janus Chess is played on a 10x8 board using all the standard chessmen plus 2 Janus pieces. These combine the powers of bishop and knight, and are placed in between the rooks and knights on the board (b1 and i1 for white, b8 and i8 for black). The king and queen are reversed compared to FIDE Chess (King on e1 and Queen on f1 for White, King on e8 and queen on f8 for black)
Note that the Janus piece can checkmate the enemy king unaided, if the king is in a corner.
Several chess grandmasters play this game, including Victor Korchnoi and Peter Leko.
Janus Chess was invented in 1978 by Werner Schöndorf.

item.description:
Jumping Chess is a chess variant played on a 10x10 board The rules are similar to those of orthodox chess, except that pieces capture by jumping over opposing pieces, as in Checkers or Draughts. The standard orthodox chess array is used, but in order to avoid uncapturable pieces at the edge of the board, two extra ranks and two extra files of edge squares are added. These edge squares can only be entered as the result of a capturing jump, and pieces sitting on them are obliged to capture if possible. The object of the game is to capture the opposing King, not to checkmate it.
This game won the Chess Variant Pages 100 Square Contest.

item.description:
Kamikaze Chess is a small, portable set of 64 tiles that can be used to play traditional chess, checkers or a custom variant of chess. 32 of the tiles become the black squares of the chessboard, with the gaps between tiles acting as the white squares. The other 32 tiles have chess pieces printed on one side and checkers printed on the other.
The namesake custom variant Kamikaze Chess introduces two changes, custom placement of pieces and action spaces:
After setting up the checkerboard, players shuffle their tiles keeping the chess symbol face down (showing the checkers side), then take turns placing their pieces on the white squares (gaps) until the board is full. Then players flip over all of the chess pieces to reveal the layout and play chess with the usual rules from that position. It is additionally suggested that one bishop on each side is moved to an adjacent black square at this point.
When players move a piece onto any black square, they flip over the tile and perform the action listed on that other side, which may be helpful or harmful. Players leave the space with the action side up and do not reactivate the actions.

Fast tactical game, Chess like, set in Arthurian's mythology universe.
You will be commanding minions as you’ll be casting powerful spells to achieve victory. Special dice will help to control changing board every turn and power hexes give you cards for conducting key maneuvers.

In a tournament version you can use a Chess Clock for a fast and full of emotion game.
